pictures.name: SD1-Bricks-And-Mortar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Ancient Egypt under a hard white sun: Hebrew slaves shape mud bricks in wooden molds and carry baskets of wet mortar beside a rising brick wall. In the middle, a young Hebrew mother in her twenties with a rust-red head cloth and a plain undyed linen dress pauses, weary, wiping her brow, a strong older man bent beside her. No whips or injuries. Dust, ochre and deep blue shadows, a mood of heavy labor and quiet dignity.

pictures.name: SD2-Night-Of-Leaving
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Moonlit night in a village of mud-brick houses in ancient Egypt: families hurry out of their doorways with bundles, goats and lamps, walking together toward the open desert. In the middle, a young Hebrew mother in her twenties with a rust-red head cloth and a plain undyed linen dress looks back once at her house. Deep blue night, warm small lamp flames, urgency and hope.

pictures.name: SD4-Flat-Bread
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Dawn in the open desert: a young Hebrew mother in her twenties with a rust-red head cloth and a plain undyed linen dress kneels by a small fire on flat stones, pressing thin round flat cakes of dough onto the hot stones to bake, while families rest nearby among tents and bundles. Pink and gold sunrise over the sand, a feeling of first freedom.
